policy.performance: Bootstrap only. After the first exact-head measurement, raw web/mobile artifact bytes become controlled ceilings. Decreases pass; increases require a reviewed baseline update with rationale.
policy.accessibility: Bootstrap only. After the first exact-head measurement, deterministic issue counts become per-route/per-rule ceilings. Decreases pass; increases fail until explicitly reviewed.
policy.runtime_timing: Observed for diagnostics only. No timing threshold is enforced until a repeatable benchmark environment and variance study exist.
policy.certification_boundary: This baseline is a regression-control artifact. It is not physical-device performance evidence, WCAG certification, store approval or market-release certification.
